title: Our class trip
instructions: Öğretmen sınıf gezisini anlatıyor. Saatleri, gerekenleri ve fiyatı karıştırma. Bu sette 3 dinleme hakkın var.

script.speaker: s
script.text: Good morning, class. Here is some information about our school trip next Tuesday.

script.speaker: s
script.text: We are going to the city museum by train.

script.speaker: s
script.text: Please be at the train station at eight o'clock. The train leaves at eight fifteen.

script.speaker: s
script.text: Bring a packed lunch and a drink. There is no café at the museum.

script.speaker: s
script.text: Wear comfortable shoes, because we are going to walk a lot.

script.speaker: s
script.text: The trip costs five pounds. Please bring the money on Friday.

script.speaker: s
script.text: We will come back to school at three thirty.
